headline: Santos' Moomba CCS passes 2 million tonnes of CO2e stored
summary: Santos said its Moomba CCS project in South Australia's Cooper Basin has stored more than 2 Mt CO2e in just over 18 months since Sept-2024 start-up; it frames the Cooper/Eromanga acreage as able to support up to 20 Mtpa for 50 years.
co2crc_note: Australia's largest onshore CCS project and a flagship Cooper Basin storage proof-point directly relevant to CO2CRC's domestic storage agenda.

headline: Mantel raises US$18m to scale molten-borate carbon capture for heavy industry
summary: MIT spin-out Mantel closed an US$18m strategic round led by Constellation Technology Ventures and Azimut (total funding ~US$50m) to commercialise a high-temperature liquid-phase (molten-borate) capture system for heavy industry, with deployments cited in Canada, West Virginia and Quebec.
co2crc_note: Next-gen high-temperature capture solvent chemistry relevant to CO2CRC's capture-cost R&D watch on alternatives to conventional amines.
